acquisition method: operated in standard data-dependent acquisition mode controlled by Xcalibur version 4.0.27.19.
alkylation reagent: The free thiols were then alkylated with freshly prepared iodoacetamide (I1149, Sigma)
alkylation concentration: added to give 10 mM final concentration, for 30 min with shaking in the dark.
cleavage agent: Trypsin/Lys-C Mix (V5071, Promega, Madison, WI) was added
collision energy: with two collision energies toggled between 25 and 30%.
instrument: analyzed on-line by using a Q-Exactive Plus mass spectrometer
labeling: The separated peptides were analyzed on-line by using a Q-Exactive Plus mass spectrometer
reduction reagent: disulfide bonds were reduced using TCEP, tris(2-carboxyethyl) phosphine
reduction concentration: at 5 mM total concentration for 30 min.
